sections.title: A historic home, *a modern salon*
body: Bloom occupies a charming 1872 Southern home, perfectly situated between Aiken's Southside and historic downtown and beside the Carolina Bay nature preserve. It is a serene setting that blends historic character with a modern, elevated salon experience.
Our skilled, creative stylists are the heart of Bloom. Each brings their own experience, passion and attention to detail, working together to create results you'll love.

image.alt: Bloom Salon's 1872 home with its white porch

sections.title: Skilled, creative, *and on your side*

image.alt: The Bloom team on the front lawn

body: Elizabeth, Caitlyn, Kate, Sarah L, Sarah B, Jessica, Jenna, Maddie, Elliot, Lauren and Audrey each bring their own experience, passion and attention to detail.
Prices vary by stylist level, length, condition, texture and complexity of service, so a consultation is where every new color guest begins.

images.alt: A styling station with heart pine floors and tall windows
A stylist curling a guest's hair
The color bar and product wall

items.a: Online booking is not available for color and chemical services, because each depends on your hair's thickness, length and condition. New color guests start with a complimentary consultation.

items.q: What forms of payment do you accept?
items.a: Mastercard, Visa, Discover, American Express, Apple Pay and Bloom gift cards. Cash is always welcome.
No. Our service providers work on commission or hourly, and tips are always appreciated.

items.q: What if I'm not feeling well?
items.a: Please consider rescheduling if you are unwell and might be contagious, so illness does not spread to other guests.
